conf.description: SharePoint Server (on-prem) uls / jdbc-sql: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: sharepoint-onprem / uls / jdbc-sql. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (logs-sharepoint_onprem.uls@custom (column rename-to-ECS; collected by an SQL/JDBC input, not a file tail)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
